Hi Logan,

Hope you’re well — I’m Dr. Emily Chao, faculty in the Edge Systems Lab at Satellite University. We ran a short pilot with Redwood for the undergrad course on applied NLP last month and the students found the Redwood runtime much faster and more predictable than what we could provision locally.

The semester runs through August 10 and we’d like to request a semester-long extension or a promotional credit package to cover the remainder of the term.

Some quick context:
- Course: CS 324 — Applied NLP and Agents (approx. 120 students, 4 lab sessions/week)
- Current trial consumption: ~180k tokens in two weeks, projected additional need: 500k–750k tokens over 10 weeks
- Use case: in-browser chat demos, batch evals on student projects, lightweight embedding experiments

Do you have an education promo or short-term credit option we can apply for? If possible we’re hoping for something that covers at least the next 3 months or a token allocation we can use before August. Happy to share the course syllabus and a short justification for your review.

Thanks — Emily
Dr. Emily Chao

Satellite University
